description: Alertes info-trafic routier Naolib de Nantes Métropole is a dataset listed in Open Data Nantes Métropole, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Nantes Métropole. Alertes info-trafic émises par le PC Circulation de Nantes Métropole Les alertes identifient le secteur concerné, la date d'effet et précisent les détails de la notification. Le territoire concerné est celui de Nantes Métropole. Il est découpé en 5 zones: Nantes Centre (intra-boulevard), Nantes Ouest, Nantes Nord, Nantes Est et Nantes Sud. Coverage: Nantes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are déplacement, Naolib, Temps réel, auto. The portal shows 5 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License-ODBL (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-nantesmetropole-fr-portal.
